title: Concept mapping as a critical thinking facilitator for generative AI-supported collaborative learning - Effects on diverse perceptions and cognitive levels
sourceFileName: 5. Concept mapping as a critical thinking facilitator for generative AI-supported collaborative learning - Effects on diverse perceptions and cognitive levels.pdf

segments.sourceText: Collaborative learning has been identified as an effective means of enhancing students’ collaboration and problem-solving skills, as well as boosting their knowledge acquisition. The advent of generative artificial intelligence (GAI) has further provided a potential tool to facilitate diverse thinking in collaborative learning. However, previous studies have revealed that students experience cognitive overload due to the vast amount of available information. To address these issues, it is necessary to provide students with tools or supports for effectively employing GAI in collaborative learning. This study proposed a concept mapping-enhanced GAI-supported collaborative learning (CM-GAI-CL) mode, and evaluated its effectiveness through a quasi-experimental design. Participants were recruited from three high school classes. One class with 33 students served as the experimental group, adopting the CM-GAI-CL mode. Another class with 26 students served as control group 1, using the conventional GAI-supported collaborative learning (C-GAI- CL) mode. The third class with 29 students served as control group 2, using the conventional collaborative learning (C-CL) mode. The results suggested that the experimental group demonstrated significantly better learning achievement, collective efficacy, critical thinking tendencies, and problem-solving skills compared to both control groups.

segments.sourceText: Collaborative learning has been recognized as an important and effective approach to fostering students’ higher order thinking as well as their collaboration and communication competences (Markula & Aksela, 2022; Quines, 2017; Rorimpandey et al., 2022). In the past decades, several previous studies have demonstrated the effectiveness of engaging students in collaborative learning tasks (Knoche, 2022; Suendarti & Virgana, 2022). For example, in a reading and writing course, Marcos et al. (2020) employed cooperative learning to encourage students to collaboratively analyze and write in groups and develop their own perspectives, and found that this approach effectively enhanced their creative thinking. However, research has indicated that when students engage in group-based problem-solving tasks without sufficient guidance or support, they may feel confused or even experience anxiety during the learning process (Tsai & Wu, 2021). When conducting conventional collaborative learning activities, teachers often manage numerous students and groups, making it difficult to adequately address the needs of each group. As indicated by several scholars, collaborative learning facilitates social negotiation and shared knowledge construction; however, it may lack sufficient structure without appropriate scaffolding (Kokku et al., 2018; Tsai & Wu, 2021); that is, providing timely guidance or immediate feedback or guidance to individual collaborative learning groups remains a critical challenge in educational contexts (Hsu et al., 2023; Kokku et al., 2018; Tsai & Wu, 2021).

translation.faithfulZh: 協作學習已被認為是培養學生高階思維及其協作和溝通能力的重要且有效的方法（Markula & Aksela, 2022; Quines, 2017; Rorimandey et al., 2022）。 在過去的幾十年中，之前的幾項研究證明了讓學生參與協作學習任務的有效性（Knoche，2022；Suendarti & Virgana，2022）。 例如，在閱讀和寫作課程中，Marcos 等人。 （2020）運用合作學習，鼓勵學生分組分析和寫作，發展自己的觀點，發現這種方法有效地增強了他們的創造性思維。 然而，研究表明，當學生在沒有足夠指導或支援的情況下從事基於小組的問題解決任務時，他們可能會在學習過程中感到困惑甚至感到焦慮（Tsai & Wu, 2021）。 在進行傳統的協作學習活動時，教師通常會管理眾多的學生和團體，因此很難充分滿足每個小組的需求。 正如幾位學者所指出的，協作學習促進了社會談判和共享知識的構建； 然而，如果沒有適當的腳手架，它可能缺乏足夠的結構（Kokku 等，2018；Tsai & Wu，2021）； 也就是說，在教育環境中為個體協作學習小組提供及時的指導或即時回饋或指導仍然是一個關鍵挑戰（Hsu 等人，2023；Kokku 等人，2018；Tsai & Wu，2021）。

segments.sourceText: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) is regarded as a potential solution to address this issue due to its ability to provide diverse and immediate responses, reducing teachers’ workloads while offering guidance or suggestions to each group of students during the collaborative learning process (Dwivedi et al., 2023; Fui-Hoon Nah et al., 2023). Nonetheless, scholars have proposed several concerns regarding adopting GAI in learning, including the provision of incorrect information and cognitive overload (Christensen et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2023). This implies that, during the GAI-supported collaborative leaning process, it may be necessary to provide additional scaffolding to help students organize what they have learned from the class and what they have derived from GAI (Hsu et al., 2023; Kasneci et al., 2023; Lin & Mubarok, 2021). In addition, GAI offers informational expansion and immediate feedback, yet it may increase cognitive load or introduce inaccurate content (Dwivedi et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2023).

translation.faithfulZh: 生成式人工智慧 (GAI) 被認為是解決此問題的潛在解決方案，因為它能夠提供多樣化和即時的響應，減少教師的工作量，同時在協作學習過程中為每組學生提供指導或建議（Dwivedi et al.， 2023；Fui-Hoon Nah et al.，2023）。 儘管如此，學者們提出了一些關於在學習中採用 GAI 的擔憂，包括提供不正確的資訊和認知超載（Christensen et al.，2024；Zhang et al.，2023）。 這意味著，在 GAI 支援的協作傾向過程中，可能有必要提供額外的腳手架，以幫助學生組織他們從課堂上學到的東西以及他們從 GAI 中學到的東西（Hsu et al.，2023； Kasneci et al.，2023；林和穆巴羅克，2021）。 此外，GAI 提供資訊擴充套件和即時回饋，但它可能會增加認知負荷或引入不準確的內容（Dwivedi et al.，2023；Zhang et al.，2023）。

segments.sourceText: To address these complementary limitations, the present study integrated GAI and collaborative learning with a concept-mapping tool as a human-mediated cognitive scaffold. Concept mapping is such a cognitive tool that aids students in visualizing information (Novak, 1983), particularly as a collaborative learning tool for co-constructing knowledge (Shi et al., 2023; Tsourela et al., 2015). Numerous studies have confirmed that concept mapping is an effective tool for promoting meaningful learning (Shi et al., 2023). It helps students identify and evaluate the relationships, significance, and differences between knowledge, thereby enhancing learning efficiency (Evans & Jeong, 2023; Machado & Carvalho, 2020). That is, during the collaborative learning process, concept mapping serves as a metacognitive and organizational scaffold that structures AI-generated information, externalizes learners’ reasoning, and supports group regulation (Ma et al., 2023; Su & Zou, 2024). In this study, students were guided to construct concept maps using the designated tool during the GAI-supported collaborative learning process to ensure that knowledge organization reflected learners’ own cognitive processing instead of automated outputs.

translation.faithfulZh: 為了解決這些互補的侷限性，本研究將 GAI 和協作學習與作為人類介導的認知支架的概念對映工具整合在一起。 概念對映是一種幫助學生視覺化資訊的認知工具（Novak，1983），特別是作為共同構建知識的協作學習工具（Shi et al.，2023；Tsourela et al.， 2015）。 大量研究證實，概念對映是促進有意義學習的有效工具（Shi et al.，2023）。 它幫助學生識別和評估知識之間的關係、重要性和差異，從而提高學習效率（Evans & Jeong, 2023; Machado & Carvalho, 2020）。 也就是說，在協作學習過程中，概念對映是一個元認知和組織的支架，它構成了人工智慧生成的資訊，將學習者的推理外化，並支援群體監管（Ma et al.，2023；Su & Zou， 2024)。 在這項研究中，學生被引導在 GAI 支援的協作學習過程中使用指定的工具構建概念圖，以確保知識組織反映了學習者自己的認知處理，而不是自動輸出。
translation.plainZh: 在這項研究中，概念對映用於組織 AI 生成的資訊，反映學習者的認知處理，而不是依賴於自動化輸出。

segments.sourceText: Grounded in Social Cognitive Theory (Bandura, 1986, 2000), the integration of structured cognitive organization and collaborative regulation is expected to enhance learners’ collective efficacy, which in turn promotes strategic engagement in complex tasks. Such strategic and metacognitive engagement fosters the development of higher-order cognitive processes, particularly critical thinking tendencies and problem-solving skills (Barta et al., 2022; Lai & Hwang, 2014). Within this framework, collective efficacy functions as a motivational driver that strengthens engagement, supports higher-order thinking, and ultimately contributes to academic achievement and learning experiences. Improvements in these cognitive and motivational processes are subsequently translated into gains in academic achievement, while learners’ perceived learning experiences represent affective–cognitive evaluations emerging from successful task engagement and collaborative functioning (Avry et al., 2020; Fredricks et al., 2004; Schunk & DiBenedetto, 2020).

translation.faithfulZh: 基於社會認知理論（Bandura, 1986, 2000），結構化認知組織和協作監管的整合有望增強學習者的集體效能，進而促進複雜任務的戰略參與。 這種戰略和元認知參與促進了高階認知過程的發展，特別是批判性思維傾向和解決問題的技能（Barta et al.，2022；Lai & Hwang，2014）。 在這個框架內，集體效能作為一個動機驅動力，可以加強參與，支援高階思維，並最終有助於學業成就和學習經歷。 這些認知和動機過程的改進隨後被轉化為學業成就的收益，而學習者的感知學習體驗則代表了成功的任務參與和協作功能中產生的情感認知評估（Avry et al.，2020； Fredricks et al.，2004；Schunk & Dibenedetto，2020）。
translation.plainZh: 這種集體功效促進了戰略參與，促進了批判性思維等高階認知過程，並最終有助於學術成就。

segments.sourceText: In the field of education, collaborative learning has been widely applied and is regarded as an effective instructional strategy for enhancing student learning (Gillies, 2003; Hron & Friedrich, 2003; Kokku et al., 2018). Several researchers have revealed that collaborative learning can significantly improve students’ academic performance (Rorimpandey et al., 2022; Suendarti & Virgana, 2022), collective efficacy (Gillies, 2019), critical thinking tendencies (Huang et al., 2017; Quines, 2017), as well as problem-solving and decision-making abilities (Knoche, 2022). These benefits can also be explained by Social Cognitive Theory, which emphasizes that learning occurs through social interaction and observational processes within a shared environment (Bandura, 1986, 2000). Building upon the foundations of collaborative learning, PBL has emerged as a structured approach that embodies its core principles. It is commonly regarded as a concrete form of collaborative learning, and is deeply inspired by the theory of social constructivism (Vygotsky, 1986). According to Vygotsky’s (1986) view of social constructivism, knowledge is constructed through social interaction, language communication, and collaborative activities in cultural contexts. In a PBL context, students discuss, reason, and share knowledge about real problems in small groups, and develop understanding and solutions through peer collaboration and reflection (Markula & Aksela, 2022; Tsai & Wu, 2021). This learning process strengthens learners’ active participation and realizes the key role of social interaction in cognitive development and knowledge construction.Krajcik and Shin’s (2014) framework of the key characteristics of PBL divides collaborative learning into different stages, namely a driving question, learning goals, scientific practices, collaboration, using technological tools, and creating an artefact, which help to enhance students’ problem-solving skills. Previous research has shown that engaging students in collaborative learning and PBL tasks can enhance not only their academic achievement but also their group self-efficacy, critical thinking tendencies, and problem-solving skills (Huang et al., 2017; Knoche, 2022; Ma et al., 2023).

translation.faithfulZh: 在教育領域，協作學習已被廣泛應用，被認為是增強學生學習的有效教學策略（Gillies，2003；Hron & Friedrich，2003；Kokku 等，2018）。 一些研究人員表明，協作學習可以顯著提高學生的學業成績（Rorimpandey 等，2022；Suendarti & Virgana，2022），集體功效（Gillies，2019），批判性思維傾向（黃等人） 2017；Quines，2017），以及解決問題和決策能力（Knoche，2022）。 這些好處也可以用社會認知理論來解釋，它強調學習是透過共享環境中的社會互動和觀察過程發生的（Bandura，1986，2000）。 在協作學習的基礎上，PBL 已成為一種體現其核心原則的結構化方法。 它通常被認為是一種具體的協作學習形式，並深受社會建構主義理論的啟發（Vygotsky，1986）。 根據 Vygotsky (1986) 的社會建構主義觀點，知識是透過社會互動、語言交流和文化背景下的協作活動構建的。 在 PBL 背景下，學生討論、推理和分享小組對小組中實際問題的瞭解，並透過同伴協作和反思來發展理解和解決方案（Markula & Aksela, 2022; Tsai & Wu, 2021）。 這一學習過程加強了學習者的積極參與，實現了社會互動在認知發展和知識構建中的關鍵作用。Krajcik和Shin（2014）PBL關鍵特徵的框架將協作學習分為不同的階段，即驅動問題、學習目標、科學實踐、 協作、使用技術工具和創造人工製品，這有助於提高學生解決問題的能力。 先前的研究表明，讓學生參與協作學習和 PBL 任務不僅可以提高他們的學業成績，還可以提高他們的團隊自我效能、批判性思維傾向和解決問題的能力（Huang et al., 2017; Knoche, 2022; Ma et al., 2023)。
translation.plainZh: 作者整理合作學習如何透過共享想法、協商與反思建立理解，也介紹與其他方法結合的研究。這些是既有文獻中的理由，還不是本研究三組的實驗結果。

segments.sourceText: Although the benefits of collaborative learning have been well verified, and approaches such as PBL are grounded in collaborative principles, simply grouping students and asking them to work together does not necessarily ensure effective collaboration or positive learning outcomes (Boud & Bearman, 2024; Gillies, 2003). Researchers have noted that when students engage in group-based problem-solving tasks without expert guidance, they may feel confused or even experience anxiety (Tsai & Wu, 2021). In traditional teaching environments, providing timely and individualized guidance can be challenging for educators (Hsu et al., 2023). Hence, implementing effective scaffolding strategies and designing appropriate learning tasks are essential for creating a supportive environment that facilitates discussion and learning (Hron & Friedrich, 2003). In recent years, some researchers have suggested employing GAI systems, such as ChatGPT, as virtual mentors to support collaborative learning (Fui-Hoon Nah et al., 2023; Lai & Tu, 2024; Weng & Chiu, 2023).

segments.sourceText: GAI, an AI technology capable of creating new content (e.g., text, images, or audio) based on input data, has recently become an important trend in the field of education (Chiu, 2023; Dwivedi et al., 2023). Large Language Models (LLMs) represent a core technological foundation of GAI in the domain of natural language processing, enabling the automated generation of coherent, contextually appropriate text based on extensive training on linguistic data (Kasneci et al., 2023). For example, ChatGPT, with its powerful language understanding and generation capabilities, can provide real-time interaction and question answering during the learning process, effectively assisting students with their knowledge construction (Jeon et al., 2023; Michel-Villarreal et al., 2023).

segments.sourceText: From the perspective of social constructivism, which emphasizes the co-construction of knowledge through social interaction, collaboration, and situated learning within meaningful contexts, the integration of GAI can enhance the diversity and depth of group discussions, thereby fostering students’ critical thinking and problem-solving abilities (Kasneci et al., 2023; Rudolph et al., 2023). Concept mapping can be understood as a metacognitive scaffolding tool that supports learners’ cognitive organization and self-regulation processes (Tsourela et al., 2015). From the perspective of Social Cognitive Theory (Bandura, 1986, 2000), such external cognitive supports may facilitate learners’ strategic engagement with complex tasks by helping them monitor, structure, and evaluate their knowledge construction processes. When integrated with collaborative learning, concept mapping may also enhance collective efficacy by enabling groups to externalize and coordinate their shared understanding. The extensive knowledge and diverse perspectives provided by GAI contribute to broadening the scope of discussions, encouraging students to engage in multifaceted thinking from various viewpoints. These diverse perspectives can then be incorporated into group discussions and problem-solving processes, thereby facilitating collaborative learning activities (Chen et al., 2023; Dwivedi et al., 2023; Neto et al., 2019). When students understand how they should work together, the potential for collaboration and learning is maximized (Gillies, 2003; Hron & Friedrich, 2003; Johnson & Johnson, 2009).

segments.sourceText: Although GAI can generate convincing narratives, previous studies have pointed out that it suffers from the problem of “hallucination,” that is, it generates information that does not correspond to the truth, but is linguistically and logically fluent, which is very likely to mislead learners (Lee et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2023). For example, when asked about the social impact of sunset industries, GAI may fabricate non-existent industrial policies, misquote inaccurate cases, or misinterpret historical facts. This may reinforce students’ misperceptions if they do not have sufficient background knowledge or critical validation skills. Some studies have raised concerns regarding the application of GAI, particularly regarding the accuracy and reliability of the information it generates, as well as its tendency to produce both relevant and irrelevant content (Dwivedi et al., 2023; Michel-Villarreal et al., 2023). Consequently, it is crucial to support students in effectively integrating the knowledge they acquire, as mere knowledge acquisition is insufficient. The key lies in how students integrate, apply, and transform their knowledge (Machado & Carvalho, 2020; Shi et al., 2023). Otherwise, engaging in discussions and interactions with GAI may fail to produce meaningful learning outcomes, and could even impose an additional cognitive load on students. Therefore, providing appropriate learning scaffolding is essential when utilizing GAI for learning, as this improves the efficiency and effectiveness of students’ interactions with AI (Kasneci et al., 2023; Lin & Mubarok, 2021).

segments.sourceText: Concept mapping is a knowledge organization tool consisting of nodes and connecting lines, where nodes represent concepts, and lines indicate the relationships between them (Novak, 1983). The use of concept mapping extends across various domains. In workplace management, it can be employed for strategic planning, problem solving, and idea communication (Yue et al., 2017). As for language education, concept mapping is used to organize and present complex textual content, as well as to support instructional strategies such as map completion and collaborative scaffolding (Su & Zou, 2024). Regarding mathematics education, teachers can utilize concept mapping to assist students in better understanding course content, thereby enhancing knowledge retention and application (Evans & Jeong, 2023). For instance, Lin et al. (2022) incorporated concept mapping into nursing courses to assist students in organizing and analyzing information, facilitating the integration of multidisciplinary theoretical knowledge. The results indicated that the experimental group demonstrated significantly higher academic performance and self-efficacy. Above all, the collaborative construction of concept mapping can serve as an effective approach to promoting learners’ knowledge construction (Shi et al., 2023; Tsourela et al., 2015).

segments.sourceText: Scholars have further indicated that concept mapping can serve as a metacognitive scaffolding tool, helping to reduce cognitive load, structure group interactions, and enhance the effectiveness of collaborative problem solving (Machado & Carvalho, 2020; Su & Zou, 2024). For example, in GAI-supported learning, concept maps can function as a shared external representation that helps learners formulate more purposeful prompts and questions, and critically evaluate information returned by the chatbot, thereby improving AI student interaction quality (Ye et al., 2025). Concept maps make learners’ conceptual structure explicit and revisable, prompting planning (what to include), monitoring (whether links are coherent), and evaluation (what is missing or unsupported) during knowledge construction (Novak, 1990). The cooperative learning literature further emphasizes that positive interdependence, individual accountability, promotive interaction, interpersonal and small-group skills, and group processing are essential dimensions that support effective collaborative learning outcomes (Johnson & Johnson, 2009; Machado & Carvalho, 2020). Aligning concept mapping with these cooperative-learning dimensions strengthens the theoretical rationale for its use in GAI-supported collaborative learning, because the shared map can operationalize interdependence and promote interaction while providing a concrete basis for accountability and group processing.

segments.sourceText: From the cognitive load perspective, concept maps act as external representations that offload working-memory demands and stabilize complex relations so that learners can allocate more resources to schema construction and meaningful integration, rather than to keeping information “in mind” (Kirsh, 2010; Sweller, 1988). This same externalization can enhance AI-student interaction by providing a shared, persistent artifact that constrains prompts, reduces ambiguity, and supports iterative cycles of querying, critiquing, and revising (Azevedo & Hadwin, 2005; Kirsh, 2010). Research on AI-supported scaffolding has suggested that structured scaffolds paired with AI agents can improve comprehension and learning processes relative to unstructured use, which supports the design rationale for using concept maps as a prompt scaffold, rather than treating AI interaction as ad hoc questioning (Yan et al., 2025).

segments.sourceText: The participants in this study were second-year high school students (11th-grade students) from a school in central Taiwan, with an average age of 17. All participants, representing three classes, volunteered to take part in the study. In adherence to ethical guidelines stipulated by the Institutional Review Board, all participant data were anonymized, and students could withdraw from the study at any time without providing a reason. One class of 33 students served as the experimental group, another class of 26 students was assigned as control group 1, and the other class of 29 students was control group 2. The experimental group adopted the CM-GAI-CL mode, control group 1 employed the GAI-CL mode, and control group 2 utilized the C-CL mode. Previous studies have demonstrated that the optimal group size for collaborative learning is three students per group (Beghetto, 2016; Gillies, 2019; Hsu et al., 2009). Free grouping was adopted by referring to the suggestions of Hsu et al. (2009) and Hu et al. (2022), with three students in each group. This allowed students to form teams according to their familiarity or learning styles so as to promote natural cooperative interactions and discussion quality. None of the participants had prior learning experience of the course unit. A pretest was administered to ensure that all students had comparable prior knowledge related to sustainability before the experiment.

(2009) 和 Hu et al. (2022) 的建議，採用了自由分組，每組有 3 名學生。 這使學生可以根據他們的熟悉度或學習方式組建團隊，以促進自然的合作互動和討論品質。 沒有一個參與者有課程單元的先前學習經驗。 進行了預測試，以確保所有學生在實驗前都具有與可持續性相關的可比先驗知識。

segments.sourceText: This study builds onKrajcik and Shin’s (2014) framework of the key characteristics of PBL. As illustrated in Fig. 1, the proposed CM-GAI-CL model includes five progressive stages designed not only to support academic development but also to foster students’ abilities to engage critically with sustainability issues, understand systemic complexity, and collaborate toward socially responsible solutions.

segments.section: 3.2. Concept mapping-enhanced GAI-supported collaborative learning (CM-GAI-CL) model
segments.sourceText: This study was conducted within the context of a course unit regarding a sustainable development issue, namely “sunset industries.” The topic was deliberately selected as a real-world, interdisciplinary sustainability challenge. It engages students in analyzing the socio-economic and environmental impacts of industrial decline and technological transformation. Through this issue, students examine how economic restructuring intersects with labor rights, ecological concerns, and policy-making, thereby promoting systems thinking. Concept mapping played a central role by helping students visualize the dynamic interconnections among technological advancement, economic policy, employment shifts, and cultural values. This process supported the construction of holistic, interconnected understandings of sustainability problems.

translation.faithfulZh: 這項研究是在一個關於可持續發展問題的課程單元的背景下進行的，即「日落行業」。 該主題被刻意選擇為現實世界的跨學科可持續性挑戰。 它讓學生分析工業衰退和技術轉型對社會經濟和環境的影響。 透過這個問題，學生研究經濟結構如何與勞動權利、生態問題和政策制定相交叉，從而促進系統思維。 概念對映透過幫助學生視覺化技術進步、經濟政策、就業轉變和文化價值觀之間的動態聯絡發揮了核心作用。 這一過程支援了對可持續性問題的整體、相互聯絡的理解。
translation.plainZh: 該研究是在一個專注於「日落工業」的課程單元中進行的，這是一個現實世界的可持續性挑戰。 它旨在透過分析工業衰退對社會經濟和環境的影響來培養學生的系統思維能力。 概念對映有助於視覺化技術、政策、就業和文化之間複雜的相互關係，幫助發展對可持續性問題的全面理解。

segments.section: 3.2. Concept mapping-enhanced GAI-supported collaborative learning (CM-GAI-CL) model
segments.sourceText: In the “Challenge and Goal Setting” stage, the teacher posed problem-based questions and guided students in understanding the learning objectives, ensuring a clear direction for the learning activity. According to Locke and Latham’s (2002) goal-setting theory, well-defined goals can enhance learners’ motivation and focus. The teacher had to not only convey information, but also guide students to examine the essence and underlying significance of the problem, fostering a comprehensive understanding of the core learning tasks. Subsequently, with the teacher’s guidance, students participated in group discussions to develop specific and achievable learning objectives. This process promoted active engagement, enabling students to share their perspectives and insights and reach a consensus. Through this collaborative effort, students gained a clear understanding of their roles and responsibilities in the learning process, thereby improving their focus and learning effectiveness. This enabled them to prepare to explore and construct knowledge by interacting with GAI in the subsequent stages.

translation.faithfulZh: 在「挑戰和目標設定」階段，教師提出基於問題的問題，引導學生理解學習目標，確保學習活動的明確方向。 根據 Locke 和 Latham (2002) 的目標設定理論，明確定義的目標可以增強學習者的動力和專注力。 教師不僅要傳達資訊，還要引導學生審視問題的本質和潛在意義，培養對核心學習任務的全面理解。 隨後，在教師的指導下，學生參加小組討論，以制定具體和可實現的學習目標。 這個過程促進了積極的參與，使學生能夠分享他們的觀點和見解並達成共識。 透過這種協作努力，學生們清楚地瞭解了他們在學習過程中的角色和責任，從而提高了他們的專注力和學習效果。 這使他們能夠準備透過在後續階段與 GAI 互動來探索和構建知識。

segments.section: 3.2. Concept mapping-enhanced GAI-supported collaborative learning (CM-GAI-CL) model
segments.sourceText: In the “GAI Exploration” stage, students interacted with GAI to gather data and explore knowledge and information related to the questions. Throughout this process, the teacher guided students in effectively engaging with GAI through a series of steps: defining questions, requesting details for clarification, developing ideas, drilling down with follow-up inquiries, and verifying the accuracy of the collected information to make necessary adjustments. According to recommendations from previous studies (Banh & Strobel; Fui-Hoon Nah et al., 2023; Hsu et al., 2023), GAI is an emerging technological tool that requires users to follow specific guidelines for more effective interaction. In the example of the “sunset industry” issue, students might ask: “What are the characteristics of a sunset industry?” and “Could you give examples of sunset industries facing labor or environmental issues?” GAI not only provided abstract concepts such as market decline, technological backwardness, and lack of growth, but also supported them with explanations and concrete terms. Students were advised to make preliminary judgments on the correctness of the information provided by GAI. These interactions could help students develop skills of critical thinking and effectively asking questions, especially by evaluating the diverse viewpoints offered by GAI.

translation.faithfulZh: 在「GAI 探索」階段，學生與 GAI 互動以收集資料並探索與問題相關的知識和資訊。 在整個過程中，教師透過一系列步驟引導學生有效地與 GAI 互動：定義問題、要求澄清細節、制定想法、深入瞭解後續調查以及驗證收集的資訊的準確性以進行必要的調整。 根據先前研究的建議（Banh & Strobel；Fui-Hoon Nah et al.，2023；Hsu et al.，2023） 互動。 在「日落產業」問題的例子中，學生可能會問：「日落行業的特徵是什麼？」 「你能舉出日落行業面臨勞動力或環境問題的例子嗎？」 GAI 不僅提供了市場衰退、技術落後和缺乏增長等抽象概念，還提供瞭解釋和具體術語的支援。 建議學生對 GAI 提供的資訊的正確性做出初步判斷。 這些互動可以幫助學生培養批判性思維和有效提問的技能，特別是透過評估 GAI 提供的不同觀點。
translation.plainZh: 在「GAI探索」階段，學生透過結構化的探究過程，利用GAI收集資訊。 根據研究建議，學生定義問題，尋求澄清，並驗證 Gai 回答的準確性（例如，「日落行業的特徵是什麼？」）。 GAI 提供了抽象的概念和解釋，促使學生批判性地評估資訊並培養與不同觀點相關的批判性思維和提問技能。

segments.section: 3.2. Concept mapping-enhanced GAI-supported collaborative learning (CM-GAI-CL) model
segments.sourceText: In the “Knowledge Organization” stage, each group collaboratively used MindMaster to construct a concept map that organized the information gathered from GAI (see Fig. 2). MindMaster was selected for its collaborative features, specifically allowing multiple students to simultaneously edit and visualize concept maps in real time. Its limitations include reliance on stable internet access and a short learning curve for students unfamiliar with digital mapping tools. The students were guided to check the information from GAI and identify the relationships between the concepts underlying the information, such as “characteristics of sunset industries,” “labor protection,” and “environmental sustainability.” They then visualized the relationships by developing concept maps. The process of constructing a concept map was not only an integration of knowledge but also a test of students’ depth of understanding. This not only aided their own comprehension and memory, but also facilitated communication and discussion among group members. Therefore, constructing a concept map further promoted student communication and collaboration, ensuring that each member actively participated in knowledge construction.

translation.faithfulZh: 在「知識組織」階段，每個小組合作使用 Mindmaster 構建一個概念圖，組織從 GAI 收集的資訊（見圖 2）。 Mindmaster 因其協作功能而被選中，特別允許多個學生實時同時編輯和視覺化概念圖。 它的侷限性包括依賴穩定的網際網路接入和不熟悉數字地圖工具的學生的短學習曲線。 學生們被引導檢查來自GAI的資訊，並確定資訊背後的概念之間的關係，例如「日落工業的特徵」、「勞動保護」和「環境可持續性」。 然後，他們透過開發概念圖來視覺化這些關係。 構建概念圖的過程不僅是知識的整合，也是對學生理解深度的考驗。 這不僅有助於他們自己的理解和記憶，而且促進了小組成員之間的交流和討論。 因此，構建概念圖進一步促進了學生的溝通與協作，確保每個成員積極參與知識構建。
translation.plainZh: 「知識組織」階段涉及使用 MindMaster 組織 GAI 收集的資訊的協作概念圖建立。 Mindmaster 的實時編輯功能促進了團隊合作，儘管它需要穩定的網際網路和一些數字素養。 學生確定了「日落行業特徵」、「勞動保護」和「環境可持續性」等概念之間的關係，以在概念圖中視覺化它們。 這一過程加深了理解、幫助理解和記憶，並促進了群體內的溝通和積極參與。

segments.section: 3.2. Concept mapping-enhanced GAI-supported collaborative learning (CM-GAI-CL) model
segments.sourceText: In the “Collaborative Verification” stage, students shared and discussed the information and perspectives they obtained from GAI within their group. They engaged in collaborative learning through the constructed concept map to verify the accuracy of concepts and make revisions accordingly (see Fig. 3). This stage focused on verifying information and reflection content in the group learning. The students were encouraged to add real-life examples (e.g., traditional retail vs. e-commerce, print publishers vs. digital media publishers), strategies to prevent sunset industries from disappearing (e.g., digital transformation, improving product or service innovation and repositioning the market), and information about their impact on the economy (e.g., employment impact, slow economic growth and supply chain impact) to their concept maps. This content comprised the learning outcomes inspired by students’ interactions with GAI and discussions with classmates. This process aligned with Vygotsky’s (1986) social constructivism, which emphasizes the promotion of knowledge internalization and construction through social interaction and collaborative learning. Students used MindMaster to display and refine their concept maps, documenting the outcomes and improvement suggestions from group discussions. Meanwhile, GAI addressed students’ advanced questions to help them add information. In addition, students continued to revise and refine their concept maps through group “collaboration,” “reflection,” and “validation.” Such processes helped the students optimize their learning outcomes by further deepening their understanding and confirming the accuracy of the information.

translation.faithfulZh: 在「合作驗證」階段，學生們分享並討論了他們從 GAI 小組中獲得的資訊和觀點。 他們透過構建的概念圖進行協作學習，以驗證概念的準確性並相應地進行修訂（見圖 3）。 這個階段的重點是驗證小組學習中的資訊和反思內容。 鼓勵學生新增現實生活中的示例（例如，傳統零售與電子商務、印刷出版商與數字媒體出版商）、防止日落行業消失的策略（例如，數字化轉型、改善產品或服務創新以及重新定位市場） 經濟（例如，就業影響、經濟增長緩慢和供應鏈影響）到他們的概念圖。 該內容包括受學生與 GAI 互動的啟發以及與同學的討論的學習成效。 這一過程與 Vygotsky (1986) 的社會建構主義相一致，強調透過社會互動和協作學習促進知識內化和構建。 學生使用 Mindmaster 展示和完善他們的概念圖，記錄小組討論中的結果和改進建議。 與此同時，GAI 解決了學生的高階問題，以幫助他們新增資訊。 此外，學生透過「協作」、「反思」和「驗證」繼續修改和完善他們的概念圖。 這些過程透過進一步加深他們的理解和確認資訊的準確性來幫助學生最佳化他們的學習成效。
translation.plainZh: 在「協作驗證」期間，學生們在他們的小組中分享了 GAI 來源的資訊和觀點，使用概念圖來評估準確性並進行修訂。 這個階段強調驗證和反思，促使學生在地圖中新增現實世界的例子、策略和經濟影響。 這些新增反映了從 GAI 互動和小組討論中學習，與社會建構主義保持一致。 學生利用 Mindmaster 改進他們的概念圖，記錄討論並整合 GAI 提供的資訊，最終最佳化他們的理解和驗證資訊。

segments.section: 3.2. Concept mapping-enhanced GAI-supported collaborative learning (CM-GAI-CL) model
segments.sourceText: Finally, in the “Creation of an Essay” stage, students created a written essay based on their acquired knowledge and inquiry findings, including conversations with GAI and the information from their concept maps. During this process, GAI assisted students in planning and formatting the essay, offering suggestions on language, organization, and structure. Additionally, students were required to integrate the knowledge they had gained, and to engage in iterative revisions until the final essay was completed. This process served not only as a summary of knowledge, but also as a comprehensive assessment of students’ learning and collaboration skills. The iterative revisions involved in the written essay aligned with the highest level of Bloom’s (1956) taxonomy of cognitive learning objectives, namely Creating, which requires students to synthesize and apply their acquired knowledge in innovative ways and express their ideas. The essay also helped students organize and summarize their learning, while enhancing their writing and communication skills (see Fig. 4).

translation.faithfulZh: 最後，在“論文的創作”階段，學生們根據他們獲得的知識和探究結果建立了一篇書面論文，包括與 GAI 的對話和他們的概念圖中的資訊。 在此過程中，GAI 協助學生規劃和格式化論文，提供有關語言、組織和結構的建議。 此外，學生被要求整合他們獲得的知識，並進行迭代修訂，直到最後的論文完成。 這個過程不僅是知識的總結，也是對學生學習和協作技能的綜合評估。 書面論文中涉及的迭代修訂符合 Bloom (1956) 的認知學習目標分類，即創造，要求學生以創新的方式綜合和應用他們獲得的知識並表達他們的想法。 這篇論文還幫助學生組織和總結了他們的學習，同時提高了他們的寫作和溝通技巧（見圖 4）。
translation.plainZh: 最後，小組整合與 GAI 的對話及概念圖資訊，合作撰寫文章。這個任務用來把前面的探索、組織與查核轉成具體作品；圖 4 是活動示例，沒有提供成效檢定。

segments.sourceText: The experimental group received training on utilizing concept mapping and GAI (i.e., ChatGPT 3.5 version), adopting the CM-GAI- CL mode for their learning activity. segments.sourceText: This study investigated the impact of the CM-GAI-CL mode on students’ learning achievement in ESD, collective efficacy, critical thinking tendencies, and problem-solving skills. The results indicated that the experimental group outperformed control groups 1 and 2 across all aspects. The research questions are discussed and conclusions presented as follows. Overall, these findings provide empirical support for the cognitive–motivational pathway proposed in this study. Consistent with Social Cognitive Theory (Bandura, 1986, 2000), the findings indicate that structured cognitive scaffolding and collaborative interaction strengthened learners’ collective efficacy, thereby facilitating strategic engagement in complex tasks. This engagement, in turn, supported the development of higher-order thinking processes, including critical thinking and problem solving, ultimately contributing to improved learning achievement and more positive learning experiences.

segments.sourceText: Regarding the first research question, the results indicated that the CM-GAI-CL mode had a significant impact on students’ learning achievement. In this collaborative learning mode, GAI served as a personalized learning guide, while concept mapping was utilized as a strategy to help students organize the information or suggestions provided by GAI. The experimental results suggest that GAI alone might not significantly enhance learning achievement, which could be due to the metacognitive laziness induced by using GAI as indicated by some researchers (Fan et al., 2025). This phenomenon manifests when learners overly rely on GAI tools to perform cognitive tasks without critical reflection on the process or the validity, appropriateness, and accuracy of the GAI output. Although no significant difference was found in the “understanding” dimension across the three learning modes, the qualitative patterns and learning behaviors observed in the experimental group suggest that concept mapping may facilitate the process of organizing and interpreting the information provided by GAI. This aligns with Chang et al. (2022) and Lin et al. (2023), who indicated that concept mapping can support learners in grasping the overall structure of complex knowledge, even when such effects might not immediately reveal statistically significant performance differences. Finally, ethical considerations remain salient in AI-assisted learning. In particular, AI bias, misinformation, and student data privacy may shape learners’ experiences and outcomes, underscoring the need for instructional guidance, monitoring, and explicit training in verification practices during AI-supported activities (Barzilai et al., 2025). For example, even when concept mapping is used to help learners structure and integrate GAI-generated ideas, students’ understanding may still be constrained if the content being organized is inaccurate or misleading and learners do not consistently apply verification strategies.

segments.sourceText: Regarding the “remembering” items, the experimental group and control group 2 outperformed control group 1. The experimental group established connections between knowledge and information using graphical and visual concept maps, which significantly enhanced memory retention (Machado & Carvalho, 2020; Shi et al., 2023). As for control group 2, familiarity with the learning mode allowed students to engage with the content more quickly, reducing the time and effort required to adapt to new technologies, thereby positively influencing their retention. While ChatGPT provided rich conversational interactions for control group 1, this mode of interaction might have increased students’ cognitive load, particularly when they needed to process large amounts of information (Dwivedi et al., 2023). The “remembering” items typically required students to recall extensive, specific knowledge quickly and effectively. Excessive reliance on conversations might divert students’ attention, thereby hindering their memory performance. With regard to the “applying and analyzing” items, the experimental group significantly outperformed the other two groups. These items typically required students to apply learned knowledge to new situations or solve real-world problems, and the use of concept mapping helped students better integrate and apply knowledge, thereby enhancing their application skills (Evans & Jeong, 2023; Machado & Carvalho, 2020). The incorporation of ChatGPT also provided richer interaction and immediate feedback, fostering students’ higher-order thinking and problem-solving skills (Chaunce & McKenna, 2023).

segments.sourceText: In addition, an analysis of the “applying and analyzing” items revealed that 11 students (33%) from the experimental group, six (23%) from control group 1, and four (14%) from control group 2 revised their selection of the sunset industry. These figures demonstrate the level of student engagement and reflection. Notably, the CM-GAI-CL mode not only increased the number of student responses, but also fostered more active participation and deeper thinking in order to understand and analyze issues related to sunset industries. Concept mapping allowed for the visualization and organization of complex information, helping students effectively integrate new and prior knowledge. This promoted a deeper understanding of the knowledge, and enhanced students’ application skills (Evans & Jeong, 2023; Shi et al., 2023). Concept mapping may also have affected performance through reduced cognitive load and improved collaboration quality. As an external representation, a concept map can lower extraneous working-memory demands during complex learning by organizing and stabilizing information, thereby freeing up resources for integration and reasoning (Sweller, 1988). At the group level, the shared map functions as a common reference point that helps coordinate attention, negotiate meaning, and ground discussion, thereby supporting structured interaction and joint problem solving (Cicognani, 2000; Simone et al., 2001). In contrast, while ChatGPT possessed advantages such as generating diverse perspectives and providing rapid responses, its effectiveness was limited without additional supporting tools. Simply relying on ChatGPT for information might not result in significant improvements in students’ learning achievement. When faced with large volumes of information, students might experience information overload and increased cognitive load. Therefore, this study highlights the necessity of integrating GAI with complementary learning strategies and technological tools. Such integration is crucial for realizing the full potential of GAI, promoting deep learning and independent thinking throughout the knowledge construction process.

segments.sourceText: With regard to the second research question, the results suggest that the experimental group demonstrated significantly higher collective efficacy compared to control groups 1 and 2. Collective efficacy plays a critical role in the collaborative learning process (Bandura et al., 1999; Park & Shin, 2022). The findings aligned with those of Chang et al. (2022) and Ma (2023), implying that the use of concept mapping positively influenced the collective efficacy. First, concept mapping enabled students to track their learning progress, thereby enhancing their confidence in completing tasks. Second, concept mapping assisted students in organizing and managing information systematically, increasing their sense of control and boosting confidence in their abilities (Park & Shin, 2022). More importantly, the creation of concept maps in this study required collaborative discussions and knowledge co-construction among students. This process enhanced students’ self-efficacy in the group, thereby facilitating more effective collaborative learning (Shi et al., 2023; Tsourela et al., 2015). These findings suggest a potential benefit of CM-GAI-CL, although alternative explanations such as novelty effects or teacher feedback may also contribute.

segments.sourceText: Moreover, this study identified three major limitations in the application of GAI in education. First, due to its limited semantic understanding, GAI sometimes failed to fully grasp the context or complex questions, leading to irrelevant or inaccurate responses. Second, this study used ChatGPT (GPT-3.5 version) because most students could not afford to purchase GPT-4.o. Since ChatGPT was primarily used for discussion and consultation during the learning activities, the selected version was adequate to support the intended learning design. However, adopting a more advanced version such as GPT-4.o in future studies may enable more diverse and sophisticated learning designs by offering improved contextual understanding, reasoning capabilities, and personalized support. Third, GAI lacks emotional or human perceptive abilities, preventing it from truly understanding or empathizing with users’ emotions and circumstances. It might also generate responses containing biases or inappropriate content, requiring students to critically evaluate and filter the information. While the teacher guided students in verifying the information provided by GAI, it is important to note that other search engines could also present incorrect information. Hence, cultivating students’ critical thinking and information filtering skills is crucial, not only for using GAI but also for various other information retrieval methods.

translation.faithfulZh: 此外，本研究確定了 GAI 在教育中應用的三個主要限制。 首先，由於其語義理解有限，GAI 有時無法完全掌握上下文或複雜的問題，導致不相關或不準確的回答。 其次，本研究使用 ChatGPT（GPT-3.5 版），因為大多數學生買不起 GPT-4.O。 由於 ChatGPT 主要用於在學習活動期間進行討論和諮詢，因此所選版本足以支援預期的學習設計。 然而，在未來的研究中採用更高階的版本，例如 GPT-4.O，可以透過提供改進的上下文理解、推理能力和個性化支援來實現更多樣化和複雜的學習設計。 第三，GAI 缺乏情感或人類的感知能力，無法真正理解或同情使用者的情緒和環境。 它還可能產生包含偏見或不恰當內容的響應，要求學生批判性地評估和過濾資訊。 在教師指導學生驗證 GAI 提供的資訊的同時，重要的是要注意其他搜尋引擎也可能提供不正確的資訊。 因此，培養學生的批判性思維和資訊過濾技能至關重要，不僅對於使用 GAI，而且對於各種其他資訊檢索方法也是如此。

segments.sourceText: Lastly, we propose the following recommendations to guide future research in exploring the challenges and potential of AI tools in education: 1. It is recommended that future research explore how to integrate GAI with other personalized learning systems or to develop further personalized AI models that can automatically adjust content and teaching methods based on students’ learning situations and performance, thereby enhancing the educational applicability of AI tools. In this context, concept mapping can be incorporated as a visual and diagnostic tool to represent students’ cognitive structures, enabling the AI system to better identify learning gaps and tailor instructional prompts accordingly. 2. Future research should integrate GAI with various teaching modes, using it as a supplementary tool rather than as the primary learning pathway. Educators could combine AI technology with conventional teaching methods to foster collaboration and discussion between teachers and students, thereby balancing the importance of technological applications with interpersonal communication. 3. The convenience of immediate feedback provided by GAI may reduce opportunities for students to engage in independent thinking. If students become accustomed to relying on GAI for answers, they may neglect the underlying logical reasoning and analytical processes, potentially leading to a decline in their cognitive abilities. Therefore, it is recommended that future educators design challenging tasks that require students to reflect, summarize, and critique after using AI. For instance, students could be asked to further explain or expand upon the AI-generated answers, ensuring that they not only understand the results but also grasp the underlying processes and principles. 4. Since GAI’s responses are based on existing data and patterns, it may not be effective in terms of fostering students’ creative thinking, particularly in situations that require divergent thinking or innovative problem solving. Future research could explore how to integrate GAI with creative learning activities, such as designing tasks that ask students to critique or expand on AIgenerated answers, thereby stimulating their creative thinking. Additionally, teachers could use GAI to generate different options or perspectives, prompting students to engage in assessments, make comparisons, and express their creativity. 5. It is also crucial to consider ethical issues, including AI bias, misinformation, and student data privacy. 6. In addition, exploring the role of teacher facilitation, cooperative learning dimensions, and the relationship between affective and metacognitive constructs may further enhance the educational effectiveness of AI-assisted learning.

translation.faithfulZh: 最後，我們提出以下建議，以指導未來的研究，以探索人工智慧工具在教育中的挑戰和潛力： 1. 建議未來的研究探索如何將 GAI 與其他個性化學習系統整合或開發進一步的個性化 AI 模型，以根據學生的學習情況自動調整內容和教學方法 效能，從而增強了人工智慧工具的教育應用能力。 在這種情況下，概念對映可以作為一種視覺和診斷工具來表示學生的認知結構，使人工智慧系統能夠更好地識別學習差距並相應地定製教學提示。 2. 未來的研究應將 GAI 與各種教學模式相結合，將其用作補充工具，而不是作為主要學習途徑。 教育工作者可以將人工智慧技術與傳統教學方法相結合，以促進教師和學生之間的協作和討論，從而平衡技術應用與人際交往的重要性。 3. GAI 提供的即時回饋的便利性可能會減少學生進行獨立思考的機會。 如果學生習慣於依靠 GAI 的答案，他們可能會忽略潛在的邏輯推理和分析過程，可能導致他們的認知能力下降。 因此，建議未來的教育工作者設計具有挑戰性的任務，要求學生在使用 AI 後進行反思、總結和批評。 例如，可以要求學生進一步解釋或擴充套件 AI 生成的答案，確保他們不僅瞭解結果，而且掌握潛在的過程和原則。 4. 由於 GAI 的反應是基於現有的資料和模式，它可能在培養學生的創造性思維方面沒有效果，特別是在需要發散思維或創新問題解決的情況下。 未來的研究可以探索如何將 GAI 與創造性的學習活動相結合，例如設計任務，要求學生批評或擴充套件 Aigenated 答案，從而激發他們的創造性思維。 此外，教師可以使用 GAI 生成不同的選項或觀點，促使學生進行評估、進行比較和表達他們的創造力。 5. 考慮道德問題，包括人工智慧偏見、錯誤資訊和學生資料隱私也很重要。 6. 此外，探索教師促進、合作學習維度的作用，以及情感和後設認知結構之間的關係，可以進一步提高 AI 輔助學習的教育效果。
translation.plainZh: 作者提出六項未來研究建議：結合個人化學習系統；把 AI 當作輔助並保留師生互動；安排反思任務避免直接依賴答案；結合創造性學習；處理偏誤、錯誤資訊與隱私等倫理問題；繼續研究教師引導、合作及情意與後設認知的關係。這些是後續方向，不是本研究已經完成的工作。

segments.sourceText: The limitations and recommendations presented in this study not only highlight the technical and social challenges of applying ChatGPT in education, but also provide innovative perspectives on how to more effectively integrate AI into educational systems. In addition, the CM-GAI-CL model developed for this study demonstrated strong theoretical and practical contributions by innovatively combining concept maps and GAI in the ESD curriculum. At the theoretical level, this study breaks through the single application of GAI tools in language learning or writing assistance, and fills the gap in the literature on how AI can support sustainability, systems thinking, and civic responsibility education. At the practical level, the CM-GAI-CL model provides educators with an operational and flexible teaching framework to help students engage in interdisciplinary thinking, critical analysis, and civic engagement when faced with authentic issues. This not only enhances students’ understanding of sustainable development, but also provides a feasible template for future AI-assisted sustainable education curriculum design, which is of far-reaching significance to the development of education technology.

translation.faithfulZh: 本研究中提出的侷限性和建議不僅突出了將 ChatGPT 應用於教育中的技術和社會挑戰，而且還為如何更有效地將人工智慧融入教育系統提供了創新的觀點。 此外，為本研究開發的 CM-GAI-CL 模型透過創新地結合 ESD 課程中的概念圖和 GAI 表現出強大的理論和實踐貢獻。 在理論層面，本研究突破了 GAI 工具在語言學習或寫作幫助中的單一應用，並填補了有關 AI 如何支援可持續性、系統思維和公民責任教育的文獻中的空白。 在實踐層面，CM-GAI-CL 模型為教育工作者提供了一個可操作且靈活的教學框架，以幫助學生在面臨真實問題時進行跨學科思維、批判性分析和公民參與。 這不僅增強了學生對可持續發展的理解，也為未來的人工智慧輔助可持續教育課程設計提供了可行的模板，這對教育技術的發展具有深遠的意義。
translation.plainZh: 本研究的侷限性和建議強調將 ChatGPT 融入教育的挑戰和創新機會。 開發的 CM-GAI-CL 模型透過結合概念圖和 GAI 來提供理論和實踐貢獻，促進人們對 AI 在可持續性、系統思維和公民參與教育中的作用的理解。 實際上，該模型為教育工作者提供了一個框架，以鼓勵跨學科思維和批判性分析，增強學生對可持續發展的理解，併為未來的人工智慧輔助課程設計提供模板。

abstract.summaryZh: 摘要 隨著科技創新的不斷髮展，現在的學習者可以從教師、同齡人、教育技術和近期的ChatGPT等生成人工智慧中獲得各種支援。 為了解決這一差距，我們進行了一項隨機實驗研究，並比較了學習者的動機、自我調節的學習過程和在不同群體支援的不同群體（即 ChatGPT）（也稱為 AI 組）、與人類專家聊天、寫作分析方面的學習表現 工具，沒有額外的工具。 結果表明：（1）接受不同學習支援的學習者在任務後內在動機方面沒有差異； (2) 組間自我調節學習過程的頻率和序列存在顯著差異； (3) ChatGPT 組在論文分數提高方面表現優於，但他們的知識增益和轉移沒有顯著差異。
abstract.faithfulZh: 隨著技術和教育創新的不斷髮展，現在的學習者可以從教師、同齡人、教育技術和最近的聊天等人工智慧中獲得各種支援。 特別是，人們對人工智慧協作和學習中的混合智慧的學術興趣激增。 混合智慧的概念仍處於新生階段，學習者如何從與人工智慧、人類專家和智慧學習系統等各種智慧體的共生關係中受益，仍然未知。 混合智慧的新興概念還缺乏對基於強大實證研究的混合人工智慧學習機制和後果的深刻見解和理解。 為了解決這一差距，我們進行了一項隨機實驗研究，並比較了學習者的動機、自我調節的學習過程和在不同群體支援的不同群體（即 ChatGPT）（也稱為 AI 組）、與人類專家聊天、寫作分析方面的學習表現 工具，沒有額外的工具。 共招募了 117 名大學生，並收集和分析了他們的多渠道學習、表現和動機資料。 結果表明：（1）接受不同學習支援的學習者在任務後內在動機方面沒有差異； (2) 組間自我調節學習過程的頻率和序列存在顯著差異； (3) ChatGPT 組在論文分數提高方面表現優於，但他們的知識增益和轉移沒有顯著差異。 我們的研究發現，在沒有動機差異的情況下，具有不同支援的學習者仍然表現出不同的自我調節學習過程，最終導致表現差異化。 特別值得注意的是，ChatGPT 等人工智慧技術可能會促進學習者對技術的依賴，並可能引發“元認知懶惰”。 總之，理解和利用不同學習者在學習中各自的優勢和劣勢在未來的混合智慧領域中至關重要。 從業者注意到關於這個主題的混合智慧結合了人類和機器智慧，旨在增強人類能力而不是取代它們，為更有效的終身學習和協作創造機會。 生成性人工智慧（如 ChatGPT）透過提供即時回饋、克服語言障礙和促進個性化教育體驗，在增強學習方面表現出潛力。 人工智慧在教育環境中的有效性各不相同，一些研究強調了它在提高學習成績和動機方面的好處，而另一些研究則指出其完全取代人類教師的能力存在侷限性。 本文補充說，我們在實驗室環境中進行了一項隨機實驗研究，並比較了學習者的動機、自我調節的學習過程和不同代理組（AI、人類專家和清單工具）的學習表現。 我們發現，ChatGPT等人工智慧技術可能會促進學習者對技術的依賴，並可能引發元認知“懶惰”，這可能會阻礙他們自我調節和深入參與學習的能力。 我們還發現 ChatGPT 可以顯著提高短期任務績效，但可能不會提高內在動機和知識的獲取和轉移。 對實踐和/或政策的影響 在學習中使用人工智慧時，學習者應專注於加深對知識的理解，並積極參與評估、監控和定位等元認知過程，而不是盲目地遵循 ChatGPT 的回饋以有效地完成任務。 在教學中使用人工智慧時，教師應考慮哪些任務適合學習者在 AI 的幫助下完成，注意激發學習者的內在動機，並開發腳手架以幫助學習者積極學習。 研究人員應該在未來設計多工和跨背景研究，以加深我們對學習者如何道德和有效地學習、監管、協作和與人工智慧發展的理解。

abstract.faithfulZh: 人工智慧 (AI) 引起了跨學科和行業的廣泛關注（Hyder 等人，Citation2019）。 人工智慧被定義為“一個系統能夠正確解釋外部資料、從這些資料中學習並透過靈活的適應來利用這些學習來實現特定的目標和任務的能力”（Kaplan & Haenlein, Citation2019, p. 15）。 人工智慧經歷了幾個發展階段和人工智慧的冬天。 在前兩個十年（即 1950 年代和 1960 年代）中，AI 展示了成功，其中包括一般問題求解器（Newell 等人，Citation1959）和 Eliza（Weizenbaum，Citation1966）等專案。 然而，處理能力的限制和人工智慧支出的減少使其發展陷入停滯。 近年來，AI在2015年推出了AlphaGo和2022年的ChatGPT後捲土重來。繼2022年末OpenAI的名為“聊天生成預訓練變壓器”或ChatGPT的應用程式釋出後，AI 引起了全世界的關注。

abstract.originalText: In traditional instruction, teachers generally deliver the content of textbooks to students via lectures, making teaching activities lack vibrancy. Moreover, in such a one-to-many teaching
abstract.faithfulZh: 在傳統教學中，教師一般透過講座將教科書的內容傳達給學生，使得教學活動缺乏活力。 此外，在這樣的一對多教學模式下，教師通常無法檢查個別學生的學習狀態或提供即時回饋以解決他們的學習問題。 聊天機器人提供瞭解決此問題的機會。 然而，傳統的聊天機器人通常充當資訊提供者（即，透過在對話中匹配關鍵字來提供相關資訊），而不是作為決策顧問（即，使用具有決策機制的知識庫來幫助使用者解決問題）。 因此，本研究提出了一個基於專家決策的聊天機器人，以促進個體學生在學習過程中構建知識。 進行了一個準實驗，以比較在地理課程活動中使用基於專家決策的聊天機器人（EDM-Chatbot）和傳統聊天機器人（C-Chatbot）在學生的表現和看法方面的差異。 一班 35 名學生是實驗組，使用 EDM-Chatbot。 其他 35 名學生是使用 C-Chatbot 的對照組。 研究結果表明，EDM-Chatbot 結合專家決策知識，顯著提高了學生的學習成績和學習樂趣，並減少了他們的學習焦慮，顯示了所提出的方法的價值。

abstract.summaryZh: 數字技術在學生的創造性思維培養中起著獨特的作用，透過有效和原創的解決方案幫助他們解決結構不佳的問題。 配對樣本 t 檢驗用於分析學生創造性思維的前後測驗，以驗證所有四種協作學習模式是否可以改善學生的創造性思維。 採用單向方差分析分析四組創造性思維的後測結果，以確定四組學生的創造性思維差異。 具體來說，教師應該讓學生以自由的方式參與集體協作學習，以培養他們的靈活性。
abstract.faithfulZh: 數字技術在學生的創造性思維培養中起著獨特的作用，透過有效和原創的解決方案幫助他們解決結構不佳的問題。 本研究在數字技術支援的人工智慧 (AI) 課程中應用了協作學習，旨在探索協作學習對四年級學生創造性思維的影響。 根據教師是否分配了領導角色並在小組中建立了最終共識，設計了四種協作學習模式以進行比較，以確定哪種模式更有效地促進學生的創造性思維。 共有37名四年級學生參加了本次研究，分為四組，每組採用四種協作學習模式中的一種。 託倫斯創造性思維測試（ttct-figure）用於測試四組學生的創作前和創作後思維。 配對樣本 t 檢驗用於分析學生創造性思維的前後測驗，以驗證所有四種協作學習模式是否可以改善學生的創造性思維。 採用單向方差分析分析四組創造性思維的後測結果，以確定四組學生的創造性思維差異。 結果表明，G1、G3 和 G4 使用的協作學習模式對提高學生的創造性思維有效，但 G2 模式並非如此。 此外，在這四種協作學習模式中，透過 AI 課程培養學生創造性思維的培養存在顯著差異。 G4 的學生具有分配的領導角色和共識，在創造性思維方面表現出最大的進步。 特別是，如果沒有指定的領導角色和共識建立，學生的創造性思維靈活性將在更大程度上得到提高。 教師可以調整本研究的結果，以便在協作學習過程中有意識地培訓團隊領導者，並引導他們達成共識，以實現在數字技術支援的課程中培養創造性思維的目標。 具體來說，教師應該讓學生以自由的方式參與集體協作學習，以培養他們的靈活性。

abstract.faithfulZh: 閱讀理解是學習的基本技能，透過廣泛的閱讀、文字討論和分析以及寫作來促進。 隨著移動技術的普及，基於人工智慧（AI）的聊天機器人結合了語音識別和語義理解，是一種潛在的語言學習工具，可以透過提供個性化的實時回饋來克服學生在傳統教學中遇到的學習困難。 然而，一些學生無法透過純文字閱讀來組織學習內容，導致學習效果不佳。 圖形組織被視為提高學生記憶力和理解力的有用策略。 該研究採用準實驗設計來研究智慧聊天機器人結合圖形摘要策略、語音識別和語義理解對學生的閱讀表現、學習經驗以及批判性和反思性思考的傾向的影響。 受試者為 107 名 10 年級學生，隨機分為四組，使用基於圖形彙總的 AI 聊天機器人、基於文字摘要的 AI 聊天機器人、基於圖形摘要的學習和基於文字摘要的學習。 結果發現，基於 AI 的聊天機器人和圖形摘要策略都透過提高學生的學習成績而使學生受益； 此外，基於 AI 的聊天機器人和圖形摘要策略之間的顯著互動進一步表明了兩者結合的有效性。 在內在動機、自我效能、批判性思維和認知負荷方面，基於人工智慧的聊天機器人比傳統教學更有利於學生； 此外，圖形摘要策略比文字摘要更有利於學生。 訪談結果進一步表明，結合圖形摘要策略和基於AI的聊天機器人使學生能夠更全面地瞭解學習內容。

abstract.faithfulZh: 合作學習的廣泛和越來越多的使用是社會和教育心理學的偉大成功案例之一。 它的成功很大程度上取決於理論、研究和實踐之間的關係。 社會相互依賴理論為建立合作學習奠定了基礎。 在過去的 11 年中，已經進行了 1,200 多項關於合作、競爭和個人主義努力的研究。 這些研究的結果驗證、修改、完善和擴充套件了該理論。 根據該理論，教師在使用正式和非正式合作學習和合作基礎小組中的作用的程式已經得到了實施。 這些程式被全世界的教育工作者廣泛使用。 這些應用導致了理論的修訂和新研究的產生。

abstract.originalText: Large language models represent a significant advancement in the field of AI. The underlying technology is key to further innovations and, despite critical views and
abstract.faithfulZh: 大型語言模型代表了人工智慧領域的重大進步。 底層技術是進一步創新的關鍵，儘管社羣和地區內有批判性觀點甚至禁令，但大型語言模型仍將繼續存在。 本文從學生和教師的角度介紹了大型語言模型教育應用的潛在好處和挑戰。 我們簡要討論了大型語言模型的當前狀態及其應用。 然後，我們強調如何使用這些模型來建立教育內容、提高學生的參與度和互動以及個性化的學習體驗。 關於挑戰，我們認為教育中的大型語言模型要求教師和學習者開發出一系列能力和識字能力，以瞭解技術以及它們的侷限性和意外脆弱性。 此外，還需要一個明確的教育系統戰略和一個明確的教學方法，重點關注批判性思維和事實核查策略，以整合和充分利用學習環境和教學課程中的大型語言模型。 其他挑戰，例如產出的潛在偏差、對持續的人工監督的需求以及誤用的可能性並不是將人工智慧應用於教育中所獨有的。 但我們相信，如果處理得明智，這些挑戰可以在教育場景中提供見解和機會，讓學生在早期瞭解潛在的社會偏見、關鍵性和人工智慧應用的風險。 最後，我們提出瞭如何應對這些挑戰並確保在教育中以負責任和道德的方式使用此類模型的建議。

abstract.originalText: Why do people create extra representations to help them make sense of situations, diagrams, illustrations, instructions and problems? The obvious explanation—external representations save internal memory
abstract.faithfulZh: 為什麼人們會建立額外的表示來幫助他們理解情況、圖表、插圖、說明和問題？ 明顯的解釋——外部表示節省了內部記憶和計算——只是故事的一部分。 我討論了外部表徵增強認知能力的七種方式：它們改變了推理格局的成本結構； 它們提供了一種可以作為可共享的思想物件的結構； 它們建立持久的參照物； 它們促進了重新表徵； 它們通常比心理表徵更自然地表示結構； 它們有助於計算更明確的資訊編碼； 它們能夠構建任意複雜的結構； 他們降低了控制思想的成本——它們有助於協調思想。 這些功能共同允許人們用外部表示比沒有外部表示更有力地思考。 它們讓我們認為以前不可思議的。

abstract.originalText: Any teacher or parent can tell you that many students are bored in school. But many of them tend to assume that boredom is not
abstract.faithfulZh: 任何老師或家長都可以告訴您，許多學生在學校感到無聊。 但他們中的許多人傾向於認為無聊不是最好的學生的問題，如果學生更加努力或學習得更好，他們就不會感到無聊。 在 1980 年代和 1990 年代，教育研究人員越來越多地意識到，當學生感到無聊和不投入時，他們學習的可能性較小（Blumenfeld 等，1991）。 對學生經驗的研究發現，幾乎所有學生在學校都很無聊，即使是那些在標準化考試中得分高的學生（Csikszentmihalyi, Rathunde, & Whalen, 1993）。 到 1990 年左右，教育研究人員很明顯問題不在於學生的錯。 學校的結構有點問題。 如果我們能找到一種方法讓學生參與他們的學習，重組課堂，讓學生有學習的動力，那將是一個巨大的變化。 同樣到 1990 年左右，對大學生的新評估表明，他們在高中獲得的知識仍然處於膚淺的水平。 即使是得分最高的學生，即頂尖大學的學生，也往往沒有對材料有更深入的概念理解——無論是在科學、文學還是數學方面（Gardner，1991）。 教育工作者今天仍然面臨這些關鍵問題。

abstract.faithfulZh: 背景教學講座和以考試為導向的學習可以使學生成為依賴死記硬背的被動學習者。 這種學習方式對他們培養核心護理價值觀和批判性思維的能力產生了負面影響。 目的 本研究旨在調查概念對映教學策略對本科生護理學生將理論生物科學知識整合到護理實踐中的能力以及他們的批判性思維和團隊合作技能的影響。 方法採用定性研究設計。 基於涉及 24 個與醫療和外科護理相關的模擬病例的概念對映策略開發了題為“成人護理病例評估和分析”的課程。 參與者是臺灣大學兩年制本科護理課程的學生。 資料是從 2020 年 9 月到 2021 年 2 月收集的。定性資料是從對 20 名學生的半結構化面對面訪談和 100 份關於學生學習旅程的反思性報告中收集的。 使用定性內容分析分析資料。 結果 確定了兩個主要主題：（1）學習方式和思維的變化和（2）學習的回報。 參與者報告說，他們的學習方式已經從依賴死記硬背學習到影象記憶，以及他們的思維過程從線性（因果）到不同層次的多方面思維。 教學和學習策略有助於提高能力感和心理安全感，從而帶來學習成就和信心。 結論 使用概念對映策略和模擬案例增強了學生的學習能力，使學生能夠整合理論知識並提高他們的思維能力。 教學和學習策略幫助參與者瞭解心理安全並增強了他們的學習信心。

abstract.faithfulZh: 運算思維 (CT) 是 21 世紀的一種必要能力。 MindTools 可以透過程式設計幫助學生理解 CT 開發過程中的概念和分解任務。 然而，由於在沒有適當指導的情況下使用 MindTools 時感到困惑，學生可能會在複雜的 CT 問題解決任務中遇到挑戰。 研究證據表明，透過調節認知活動，在複雜的 CT 問題解決中進行反思的潛力。 因此，本研究設計了一種反思引導的視覺化 MindTool 策略來應對 CT 發展挑戰。 透過招募 97 名初中學生來檢查所提出的策略對 CT 發展的影響並探索學生的行為模式，進行了準實驗和滯後順序分析。 結果表明，該方法提高了學生的 CT 表現、CT 性格、元認知意識和學習動機。 與對照組中的學生相比，學習所提出的策略的學生表現出更多的關鍵行為，即促進 CT 問題解決（例如，概括知識、重新設計演算法方案和評估他們提出的方案的可行性），揭示了 CT 發展的基本過程 並啟發教師在培養 CT 時指導學生進行此類學習過程。

abstract.faithfulZh: 本多案例研究的目的是研究專題式學習 (PBL) 的關鍵特徵以及教師如何在科學教育的背景下實施這些特徵。 K-12 科學教師及其學生的影片、學習日記和線上問卷回答關於他們在主題自然和環境中的生物學相關 PBL 單元，使用演繹和歸納內容分析（n = 12 所學校）進行了分析。 所研究的教師積極參與 PBL，因為學校自願參加了芬蘭盧馬中心的國際啟動計劃。 結果表明，PBL 可能專門促進使用協作、人工製品、技術工具、以問題為中心和某些科學實踐，例如進行研究、展示結果和科學教育中的反思。 然而，驅動問題、學生設定的學習目標、學生的問題、專案活動的完整性以及將專案作為學習中心內容的手段似乎更具挑戰性。 此外，儘管科學實踐在專案中發揮了重要作用，但無法定義學生領導的調查有多強烈。 該研究還表明，學生和教師可能會關注透過 PBL 進行的學習的不同方面。 這些結果有助於更深入地瞭解與實施 PBL 和在課堂上使用科學實踐相關的可能性和挑戰。 此外，結果和關鍵特徵的構建框架可用於促進基於研究的 PBL 科學教育的實施和設計，以及與之相關的教師培訓。

abstract.originalText: ChatGPT is the world’s most advanced chatbot thus far. Unlike other chatbots, it can create impressive prose within seconds, and it has created much hype
abstract.faithfulZh: ChatGPT 是迄今為止世界上最先進的聊天機器人。 與其他聊天機器人不同，它可以在幾秒鐘內創造出令人印象深刻的散文，並且在高等教育和許多其他問題的學生評估方面創造了許多炒作和世界末日預測。 ChatGPT 是一種最先進的語言模型（OpenAI 的生成預訓練變換器 (GPT) 語言模型的一種變體），旨在生成與人類所寫的文字無法區分的文字。 它可以以看似自然和直觀的方式與使用者進行對話。 在本文中，我們簡要地講述了 ChatGPT 背後的組織 OpenAI 的故事。 我們強調從非營利組織到商業商業模式的根本性變化。 在我們的方法方面，我們進行了廣泛的文獻回顧並試驗了這種人工智慧 (AI) 軟體。 我們的文獻綜述表明，我們的評論是第一個探索 ChatGPT 及其與高等教育相關性（尤其是評估、學習和教學）的同行評審的學術期刊文章之一。 在描述了 ChatGPT 的功能及其優勢和侷限性的總結之後，我們專注於該技術對高等教育的影響，並在 ChatGPT 等人工智慧聊天機器人的背景下討論高等教育中的學習、教學和評估的未來是什麼。 我們將 ChatGPT 定位在當前教育 (AIED) 研究中的人工智慧 (AIED) 研究的背景下，討論面向學生、面向教師和麵向系統的應用程式，並分析機會和威脅。 我們在本文中為學生、教師和高等教育機構提供了建議。 他們中的許多人專注於評估。

abstract.faithfulZh: 本文從班杜拉的社會認知理論的角度討論動機。 動機是指激發和維持目標導向活動的過程。 動機過程是個人/內部影響，會導致選擇、努力、堅持、成就和環境監管等結果。 從早期建模研究到涉及代理的當前概念，動機一直是社會認知理論的一個突出特徵。 討論了互惠互動的概念框架，之後對行為、環境和個人對動機的影響進行了總結。 關鍵的內部動機過程是進度、自我效能、社會比較、價值觀、結果期望、歸因和自我調節的目標和自我評估。 該理論面臨的關鍵問題包括多樣性和文化、方法論和干預措施的長期影響。 本文最後為未來對背景、概念清晰度和技術的研究提出了額外的建議。

abstract.faithfulZh: 思維導圖是教學中使用的視覺化工具，可以被學習者應用來產生想法、做筆記、組織思維和發展概念。 使用思維導圖的教學正變得越來越常用於教育中。 然而，關於基於思維導圖的教學對學生學習成果的有效性，研究產生了不一致的結果。 使用 21 項研究的薈萃分析，本研究調查了基於思維導圖的指令對學生學習成果的整體有效性，與傳統教學相比。 與傳統教學相比，基於思維導圖的教學對學生的認知學習成果有更大的積極影響。 對調節變數的分析表明，主題和教育水平是基於思維導圖的教學有效性的重要因素。 與高年級學生相比，低年級學生更容易受到基於思維導圖的教學的影響，而基於思維導圖的教學可以幫助學生提高所有學科的認知學習成果，特別是在科學、技術、工程和數學學科中。

abstract.originalText: Concept mapping-based language learning (CMLL) has attracted increasing attention from the research community. Many studies have investigated non-technology-based CMLL (NTCMLL) and technology-based CMLL (TCMLL); however,
abstract.faithfulZh: 基於概念對映的語言學習 (CMLL) 引起了研究界越來越多的關注。 許多研究調查了基於非技術的 CMLL (NTCMLL) 和基於技術的 CMLL (TCMLL)； 然而，文獻沒有顯示將兩者進行比較，這是必要的，因為這可以確定技術和非基於技術的 CM 活動在協助語言學習方面的差異化適用性。 因此，本研究回顧了 26 項比較 NTCMLL 與 TCMLL 關於出版性質、理論框架、目標語言、學習成果、CM 活動和用於概念對映技術的研究。 結果表明，(a) NTCMLL 和 TCMLL 研究自 2016 年以來變得流行； (b) 有意義的學習是最常見的理論支援； (c) 英語是最常被調查的語言； (d) 討論最多的學習成果是語言習得和心理狀態； (e) 經常使用個人概念對映； (f) 現成工具的應用比研究人員的自開發系統更多。 我們還確定了 NTCMLL 和 TCMLL 研究之間的異同，同時討論了對它們未來設計的重要影響。

abstract.faithfulZh: 線上資訊問題解決 (OIPS) 對於 21 世紀的資訊素養至關重要，這通常需要資訊選擇能力。 然而，學生通常在從複雜的網路資源中區分資訊方面遇到問題。 這項研究利用眼動追蹤技術，旨在檢查網路搜尋環境中學習者視覺搜尋模式、資訊焦慮和 OIPS 任務表現之間的關係。 在這項研究中，46 名大學生自願參加了一項解決滑坡問題的網路搜尋任務。 學生的視覺行為在任務期間由眼動追蹤者記錄，任務後立即自我報告資訊焦慮。 還記錄和評分反應時間和任務表現。 進行了 Pearson 的相關性分析、多元迴歸分析、聚類分析和滯後順序分析 (LSA)。 結果表明，學習者的眼動追蹤測量、資訊焦慮和任務表現在 OIPS 中顯著相關。 學生對不相關的網路資訊的視覺注意力可以顯著而積極地預測他們的資訊焦慮，但對他們的任務表現進行負面預測。 此外，基於眼動追蹤測量和反應時間，確定了三種視覺搜尋模式：混亂、思維緩慢和快速思考。 LSA 結果進一步表明，不同的群體使用不同的資訊選擇和注意力控制策略，尤其是在區分 Web 資訊的相關性時。 本研究在 OIPS 環境中連線眼動追蹤測量、資訊焦慮和任務表現之間的關聯。 建議未來的研究使用聚類分析和 LSA 分析眼動追蹤資料，以在視覺搜尋或資訊處理模式方面分析線上學習者的特徵。

abstract.originalText: Research on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in language education becomes more popular. This revolutionary technology is regarded as a promising tool to assist language learning environments
abstract.faithfulZh: 語言教育中對人工智慧（AI）的研究變得越來越流行。 這種革命性的技術被認為是一種有前途的工具，可以透過支援自動回饋、智慧輔導和個性化來幫助語言學習環境。 在設計智慧計算機輔助語言學習 (ICALL) 環境的同時，教育工作者遵循了教學第一原則 (FPI)，包括以問題為中心、啟用、演示、應用和整合。 這些教學設計原則是可以採用的，因為它們為學習活動提供瞭解決問題的重點，滿足了學習者與過程相關性的需求。 儘管在 ICALL 環境中使用了不同的教學設計原則，並報告了它們對學生學習結果的相應影響，但很少有研究人員以系統的評價方法檢查相關研究，而更少的學者探索了所採用的教學設計原則的挑戰。 為了填補這一空白，我們對來自 Web of Science、Eric、Scopus 和 ProQuest 社會科學資料庫的 83 篇相關論文進行了系統評價。 我們旨在研究 FPI 在 ICALL 中的應用，並提出兩個研究問題：（1）ICALL 環境如何從 FPI 的角度促進學習？ (2) ICALL 環境面臨哪些挑戰？ 內容分析和主題分析用於分析收集的論文。 我們的研究結果揭示了自動回饋的演示和應用原則的應用、智慧輔導的啟用原理以及以問題為中心的個性化整合原則。 同時，我們討論了這些研究的挑戰，並提出了教學設計見解和對教育實踐的經驗建議。

abstract.originalText: Visual learning analytics (VLA) is becoming increasingly adopted in educational technologies and learning analytics dashboards to convey critical insights to students and educators. Yet many
abstract.faithfulZh: 視覺學習分析 (VLA) 越來越多地被教育技術和學習分析儀表板採用，以向學生和教育工作者傳達重要的見解。 然而，由於資料視覺化素養有限，許多學生在理解複雜 VLA 方面遇到了困難。 雖然像資料講故事這樣的傳統腳手架方法已顯示出在提高學生對 VLA 的理解方面的有效性，但這些方法仍然難以擴充套件和適應個人學習需求。 生成式 AI (Genai) 技術，尤其是對話代理，透過提供個性化和動態支援來增強學生對 VLA 的理解，提供了潛在的解決方案。 這項對照實驗室研究調查了 Genai 代理在提高學生對 VLA 的理解方面的有效性，特別是與腳手架技術相結合時。 對 117 名高等教育學生進行了一項隨機對照試驗，以比較兩種型別的 Genai 代理的影響：被動代理人（響應學生查詢的被動代理人）和利用腳手架問題的主動代理與 VLA 理解任務中的獨立腳手架進行比較。 結果表明，在干預期間和干預之後，被動劑對獨立腳手架產生了可比的改進。 值得注意的是，與被動代理和獨立腳手架相比，主動 Genai 代理顯著增強了學生的 VLA 理解能力，這些好處在干預之外持續存在。 這些發現表明，將 Genai 代理與腳手架結合起來可以對學生的理解能力產生持久的積極影響，並支援真正的學習。

abstract.originalText: With the development of the times, programming education has become increasingly important for individual development. However, for programming beginners such as primary and secondary school
abstract.faithfulZh: 隨著時代的發展，程式設計教育對個人發展變得越來越重要。 然而，對於中小學生等程式設計初學者來說，學習程式設計並不是一項簡單的任務，需要額外的學習支援。 Generative AI (Genai) 聊天機器人是一種有效的教具，可以透過根據學生的能力提供實時指導和個性化學習支援來降低程式設計的學習難度。 因此，在教學中應用 Genai 聊天機器人一直是一種趨勢。 然而，技術總是有兩個方面。 過度依賴這些聊天機器人可能會削弱學生獨立思考的能力，並影響他們的學習效果。 因此，如何在課堂上合理利用 Genai 聊天機器人並提高其應用效率已成為研究人員和一線教師的一個重要問題。 基於此，本研究提出了一種將思維對映與 Genai 聊天機器人整合的學習方法。 為了評估這種學習方法的有效性，並研究各種型別的思維導圖支援的 Genai 聊天機器人對學生程式設計學習成績、運算思維和程式設計自我效能的影響是否存在差異，研究團隊進行了準實驗研究。 參與者是中國東南部一所中學的111名七年級學生。 實驗組 1（36 名學生）使用了一種學習方法，將漸進式思維圖與生成式 AI 聊天機器人整合，實驗組 2（36 名學生）使用學習方法，將自建思維圖與 Genai 聊天機器人整合，對照組（39 名學生）使用 傳統的基於AI聊天機器人的學習方法。 結果表明，兩個實驗組的參與者都比對照組具有更好的程式設計學習效能和運算思維，並且將漸進式思維對映與 Genai 聊天機器人相結合的學習方法更有效。

abstract.faithfulZh: 【摘要】：作為日常臨床護理實踐中的重要技能,批判性思維能力一直是護理教育的一個重要目標。 概念對映使護理專業的學生將新資訊與現有知識聯絡起來，並整合跨學科知識。 然而，在護理教育中缺乏與批判性思維能力和概念對映有關的證據。 本系統評價和薈萃分析的目的是評估概念對映在護理教育中批判性思維中的效果。 設計 本系統評價與系統評價和薈萃分析 (PRISMA) 的首選報告專案一致。 資料來源 在 PubMed、Web of Science、EMBASE、Cochrane Central Register of Controls of Controller Register (Central)、護理與聯合健康累積指數 (CINAHL) 和中國國家知識基礎設施 (CNKI) 中進行了搜尋。 檢索了比較概念對映和傳統教學方法的隨機對照試驗 (RCT)。 審查方法 資料由兩名審稿人根據資料提取表收集。 納入研究的方法學品質由其他兩名評審員評估。 使用平均差（MD）提供薈萃分析結果。 結果 13 項試驗總結在系統評價中，11 項試驗納入薈萃分析。 彙總效應量表明，與傳統方法相比，概念對映可以提高受試者的批判性思維能力，透過加州批判性思維處置量表 (CCTDI)、加州批判性思維技能測試 (CCTST) 和批判性思維量表 (CTS) 測量。 亞組分析表明，概念對映提高了所有子量表的分數。 結論 本綜述的結果表明，概念對映可以影響批判性思維情感傾向和批判性思維認知技能。 需要使用統一評估進行進一步的高品質研究。

previousSegments.sourceText: In the field of education, collaborative learning has been widely applied and is regarded as an effective instructional strategy for enhancing student learning (Gillies, 2003; Hron & Friedrich, 2003; Kokku et al., 2018). Several researchers have revealed that collaborative learning can significantly improve students’ academic performance (Rorimpandey et al., 2022; Suendarti & Virgana, 2022), collective efficacy (Gillies, 2019), critical thinking tendencies (Huang et al., 2017; Quines, 2017), as well as problem-solving and decision-making abilities (Knoche, 2022). These benefits can also be explained by Social Cognitive Theory, which emphasizes that learning occurs through social interaction and observational processes within a shared environment (Bandura, 1986, 2000). Building upon the foundations of collaborative learning, PBL has emerged as a structured approach that embodies its core principles. It is commonly regarded as a concrete form of collaborative learning, and is deeply inspired by the theory of social constructivism (Vygotsky, 1986). According to Vygotsky’s (1986) view of social constructivism, knowledge is constructed through social interaction, language communication, and collaborative activities in cultural contexts. In a PBL context, students discuss, reason, and share knowledge about real problems in small groups, and develop understanding and solutions through peer collaboration and reflection

previousSegments.sourceText: 1. It is recommended that future research explore how to integrate GAI with other personalized learning systems or to develop further personalized AI models that can automatically adjust content and teaching methods based on students’ learning situations and performance, thereby enhancing the educational applicability of AI tools. In this context, concept mapping can be incorporated as a visual and diagnostic tool to represent students’ cognitive structures, enabling the AI system to better identify learning gaps and tailor instructional prompts accordingly. 2. Future research should integrate GAI with various teaching modes, using it as a supplementary tool rather than as the primary learning pathway. Educators could combine AI technology with conventional teaching methods to foster collaboration and discussion between teachers and students, thereby balancing the importance of technological applications with interpersonal communication. 3. The convenience of immediate feedback provided by GAI may reduce opportunities for students to engage in independent thinking. If students become accustomed to relying on GAI for answers, they may neglect the underlying logical reasoning and analytical processes, potentially leading to a decline in their cognitive abilities. Therefore, it is recommended that future educators design challenging tasks that require students to reflect, summarize, and critique after using AI. For instance, students could be asked to further explain or expand upon the AI-generated answers, ensuring that they not only understand the results but also grasp the underlying processes and principles. 4. Since GAI’s responses are based on existing data and patterns, it may not be effective in terms of fostering students’ creative thinking, particularly in situations that require divergent thinking or innovative problem solving. Future research could explore how to integrate GAI with creative learning activities, such as designing tasks that ask students to critique or expand on AIgenerated answers, thereby stimulating their creative thinking. Additionally, teachers could use GAI to generate different options or perspectives, prompting students to engage in assessments, make comparisons, and express their creativity. 5. It is also crucial to consider ethical issues, including AI bias, misinformation, and student data privacy. 6. In addition, exploring the role of teacher facilitation, cooperative learning dimensions, and the relationship between affective and metacognitive constructs may further enhance the educational effectiveness of AI-assisted learning.

GAI 提供的即時回饋的便利性可能會減少學生進行獨立思考的機會。 如果學生習慣於依靠 GAI 的答案，他們可能會忽略潛在的邏輯推理和分析過程，可能導致他們的認知能力下降。 因此，建議未來的教育工作者設計具有挑戰性的任務，要求學生在使用 AI 後進行反思、總結和批評。 例如，可以要求學生進一步解釋或擴充套件 AI 生成的答案，確保他們不僅瞭解結果，而且掌握潛在的過程和原則。 4. 由於 GAI 的反應是基於現有的資料和模式，它可能在培養學生的創造性思維方面沒有效果，特別是在需要發散思維或創新問題解決的情況下。 未來的研究可以探索如何將 GAI 與創造性的學習活動相結合，例如設計任務，要求學生批評或擴充套件 Aigenated 答案，從而激發他們的創造性思維。 此外，教師可以使用 GAI 生成不同的選項或觀點，促使學生進行評估、進行比較和表達他們的創造力。 5. 考慮道德問題，包括人工智慧偏見、錯誤資訊和學生資料隱私也很重要。 6. 此外，探索教師促進、合作學習維度的作用，以及情感和元認知結構之間的關係，可以進一步提高 AI 輔助學習的教育效果。

links.evidenceQuote: This study builds onKrajcik and Shin’s (2014) framework of the key characteristics of PBL. As illustrated in Fig. 1, the proposed CM-GAI-CL model includes five progressive stages designed not only to support academic development but also to foster students’ abilities to engage critically with sustainability issues, understand systemic complexity, and collaborate toward socially responsible solutions.

links.evidenceQuote: In the “Knowledge Organization” stage, each group collaboratively used MindMaster to construct a concept map that organized the information gathered from GAI (see Fig. 2). MindMaster was selected for its collaborative features, specifically allowing multiple students to simultaneously edit and visualize concept maps in real time. Its limitations include reliance on stable internet access and a short learning curve for students unfamiliar with digital mapping tools. The students were guided to check the information from GAI and identify the relationships between the concepts underlying the information, such as “characteristics of sunset industries,” “labor protection,” and “environmental sustainability.” They then visualized the relationships by developing concept maps. The process of constructing a concept map was not only an integration of knowledge but also a test of students’ depth of understanding. This not only aided their own comprehension and memory, but also facilitated communication and discussion among group members. Therefore, constructing a concept map further promoted student communication and collaboration, ensuring that each member actively participated in knowledge construction.

links.relationshipZh: 本段明確提及 Figure 3，可用完整原圖表核對「小組合作查核與修訂概念圖」。提及圖號不代表本段已解釋全部內容。
links.evidenceQuote: In the “Collaborative Verification” stage, students shared and discussed the information and perspectives they obtained from GAI within their group. They engaged in collaborative learning through the constructed concept map to verify the accuracy of concepts and make revisions accordingly (see Fig. 3). This stage focused on verifying information and reflection content in the group learning. The students were encouraged to add real-life examples (e.g., traditional retail vs. e-commerce, print publishers vs. digital media publishers), strategies to prevent sunset industries from disappearing (e.g., digital transformation, improving product or service innovation and repositioning the market), and information about their impact on the economy (e.g., employment impact, slow economic growth and supply chain impact) to their concept maps. This content comprised the learning outcomes inspired by students’ interactions with GAI and discussions with classmates. This process aligned with Vygotsky’s (1986) social constructivism, which emphasizes the promotion of knowledge internalization and construction through social interaction and collaborative learning. Students used MindMaster to display and refine their concept maps, documenting the outcomes and improvement suggestions from group discussions. Meanwhile, GAI addressed students’ advanced questions to help them add information. In addition, students continued to revise and refine their concept maps through group “collaboration,” “reflection,” and “validation.” Such processes helped the students optimize their learning outcomes by further deepening their understanding and confirming the accuracy of the information.

links.evidenceQuote: Finally, in the “Creation of an Essay” stage, students created a written essay based on their acquired knowledge and inquiry findings, including conversations with GAI and the information from their concept maps. During this process, GAI assisted students in planning and formatting the essay, offering suggestions on language, organization, and structure. Additionally, students were required to integrate the knowledge they had gained, and to engage in iterative revisions until the final essay was completed. This process served not only as a summary of knowledge, but also as a comprehensive assessment of students’ learning and collaboration skills. The iterative revisions involved in the written essay aligned with the highest level of Bloom’s (1956) taxonomy of cognitive learning objectives, namely Creating, which requires students to synthesize and apply their acquired knowledge in innovative ways and express their ideas. The essay also helped students organize and summarize their learning, while enhancing their writing and communication skills (see Fig. 4).

explanationRepairs.sourceText: Lastly, we propose the following recommendations to guide future research in exploring the challenges and potential of AI tools in education: 1. It is recommended that future research explore how to integrate GAI with other personalized learning systems or to develop further personalized AI models that can automatically adjust content and teaching methods based on students’ learning situations and performance, thereby enhancing the educational applicability of AI tools. In this context, concept mapping can be incorporated as a visual and diagnostic tool to represent students’ cognitive structures, enabling the AI system to better identify learning gaps and tailor instructional prompts accordingly. 2. Future research should integrate GAI with various teaching modes, using it as a supplementary tool rather than as the primary learning pathway. Educators could combine AI technology with conventional teaching methods to foster collaboration and discussion between teachers and students, thereby balancing the importance of technological applications with interpersonal communication. 3. The convenience of immediate feedback provided by GAI may reduce opportunities for students to engage in independent thinking. If students become accustomed to relying on GAI for answers, they may neglect the underlying logical reasoning and analytical processes, potentially leading to a decline in their cognitive abilities. Therefore, it is recommended that future educators design challenging tasks that require students to reflect, summarize, and critique after using AI. For instance, students could be asked to further explain or expand upon the AI-generated answers, ensuring that they not only understand the results but also grasp the underlying processes and principles. 4. Since GAI’s responses are based on existing data and patterns, it may not be effective in terms of fostering students’ creative thinking, particularly in situations that require divergent thinking or innovative problem solving. Future research could explore how to integrate GAI with creative learning activities, such as designing tasks that ask students to critique or expand on AIgenerated answers, thereby stimulating their creative thinking. Additionally, teachers could use GAI to generate different options or perspectives, prompting students to engage in assessments, make comparisons, and express their creativity. 5. It is also crucial to consider ethical issues, including AI bias, misinformation, and student data privacy. 6. In addition, exploring the role of teacher facilitation, cooperative learning dimensions, and the relationship between affective and metacognitive constructs may further enhance the educational effectiveness of AI-assisted learning.

GAI 提供的即時回饋的便利性可能會減少學生進行獨立思考的機會。 如果學生習慣於依靠 GAI 的答案，他們可能會忽略潛在的邏輯推理和分析過程，可能導致他們的認知能力下降。 因此，建議未來的教育工作者設計具有挑戰性的任務，要求學生在使用 AI 後進行反思、總結和批評。 例如，可以要求學生進一步解釋或擴充套件 AI 生成的答案，確保他們不僅瞭解結果，而且掌握潛在的過程和原則。 4. 由於 GAI 的反應是基於現有的資料和模式，它可能在培養學生的創造性思維方面沒有效果，特別是在需要發散思維或創新問題解決的情況下。 未來的研究可以探索如何將 GAI 與創造性的學習活動相結合，例如設計任務，要求學生批評或擴充套件 Aigenated 答案，從而激發他們的創造性思維。 此外，教師可以使用 GAI 生成不同的選項或觀點，促使學生進行評估、進行比較和表達他們的創造力。 5. 考慮道德問題，包括人工智慧偏見、錯誤資訊和學生資料隱私也很重要。 6. 此外，探索教師促進、合作學習維度的作用，以及情感和後設認知結構之間的關係，可以進一步提高 AI 輔助學習的教育效果。

explanationRepairs.sourceText: Collaborative learning has been recognized as an important and effective approach to fostering students’ higher order thinking as well as their collaboration and communication competences (Markula & Aksela, 2022; Quines, 2017; Rorimpandey et al., 2022). In the past decades, several previous studies have demonstrated the effectiveness of engaging students in collaborative learning tasks (Knoche, 2022; Suendarti & Virgana, 2022). For example, in a reading and writing course, Marcos et al. (2020) employed cooperative learning to encourage students to collaboratively analyze and write in groups and develop their own perspectives, and found that this approach effectively enhanced their creative thinking. However, research has indicated that when students engage in group-based problem-solving tasks without sufficient guidance or support, they may feel confused or even experience anxiety during the learning process (Tsai & Wu, 2021). When conducting conventional collaborative learning activities, teachers often manage numerous students and groups, making it difficult to adequately address the needs of each group. As indicated by several scholars, collaborative learning facilitates social negotiation and shared knowledge construction; however, it may lack sufficient structure without appropriate scaffolding (Kokku et al., 2018; Tsai & Wu, 2021); that is, providing timely guidance or immediate feedback or guidance to individual collaborative learning groups remains a critical challenge in educational contexts (Hsu et al., 2023; Kokku et al., 2018; Tsai & Wu, 2021).

explanationRepairs.sourceText: In the field of education, collaborative learning has been widely applied and is regarded as an effective instructional strategy for enhancing student learning (Gillies, 2003; Hron & Friedrich, 2003; Kokku et al., 2018). Several researchers have revealed that collaborative learning can significantly improve students’ academic performance (Rorimpandey et al., 2022; Suendarti & Virgana, 2022), collective efficacy (Gillies, 2019), critical thinking tendencies (Huang et al., 2017; Quines, 2017), as well as problem-solving and decision-making abilities (Knoche, 2022). These benefits can also be explained by Social Cognitive Theory, which emphasizes that learning occurs through social interaction and observational processes within a shared environment (Bandura, 1986, 2000). Building upon the foundations of collaborative learning, PBL has emerged as a structured approach that embodies its core principles. It is commonly regarded as a concrete form of collaborative learning, and is deeply inspired by the theory of social constructivism (Vygotsky, 1986). According to Vygotsky’s (1986) view of social constructivism, knowledge is constructed through social interaction, language communication, and collaborative activities in cultural contexts. In a PBL context, students discuss, reason, and share knowledge about real problems in small groups, and develop understanding and solutions through peer collaboration and reflection (Markula & Aksela, 2022; Tsai & Wu, 2021). This learning process strengthens learners’ active participation and realizes the key role of social interaction in cognitive development and knowledge construction.Krajcik and Shin’s (2014) framework of the key characteristics of PBL divides collaborative learning into different stages, namely a driving question, learning goals, scientific practices, collaboration, using technological tools, and creating an artefact, which help to enhance students’ problem-solving skills. Previous research has shown that engaging students in collaborative learning and PBL tasks can enhance not only their academic achievement but also their group self-efficacy, critical thinking tendencies, and problem-solving skills (Huang et al., 2017; Knoche, 2022; Ma et al., 2023).

explanationRepairs.sourceText: Finally, in the “Creation of an Essay” stage, students created a written essay based on their acquired knowledge and inquiry findings, including conversations with GAI and the information from their concept maps. During this process, GAI assisted students in planning and formatting the essay, offering suggestions on language, organization, and structure. Additionally, students were required to integrate the knowledge they had gained, and to engage in iterative revisions until the final essay was completed. This process served not only as a summary of knowledge, but also as a comprehensive assessment of students’ learning and collaboration skills. The iterative revisions involved in the written essay aligned with the highest level of Bloom’s (1956) taxonomy of cognitive learning objectives, namely Creating, which requires students to synthesize and apply their acquired knowledge in innovative ways and express their ideas. The essay also helped students organize and summarize their learning, while enhancing their writing and communication skills (see Fig. 4).
